intro: Azerbaijan is a presidential republic in which power is concentrated in the president and his family.

chapters.title: How it works
text: President Ilham Aliyev has ruled since 2003, after his father. His wife Mehriban is first vice-president. International observers have criticised elections and the jailing of journalists.

chapters.title: Neighbours
text: Azerbaijan is a close ally of Turkey. In 2025 it agreed the text of a peace deal with Armenia.
